name: StarUML
description: A commercial cross-platform UML modeling application with an extension API, model validation, JavaScript code generation, and team-oriented capabilities.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina UML tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: 曾经是最流行的开源UML工具，多年沉寂后重新开发，现已收费。开放API，支持HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript和Node.js编写扩展。模型验证，JavaScript代码生成。支持团队开发。
